final: WITH ig AS (SELECT ft.invoice_number AS inv, c.gender AS g, AVG(ft.transaction_amount) AS a FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Invoices i ON i.invoice_number = ft.invoice_number JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY ft.invoice_number, c.gender), gg AS (SELECT g, AVG(a) AS ga FROM ig GROUP BY g), ov AS (SELECT AVG(ga) AS oa FROM gg), kept AS (SELECT gg.ga AS ga, gg.ga - ov.oa AS ex FROM gg, ov WHERE gg.ga > ov.oa) SELECT AVG(ga) AS avg_kept_gender_avg, AVG(ex) AS avg_excess FROM kept
